About us

Harbor Robotics was founded in 2019 by port engineers who were tired of watching ships wait days for a berth. Today our machines work in six ports across North America and Europe, and we partner with terminal operators to automate the slowest parts of the yard.

What we value

  • Safety is the first feature. Nothing ships until it is safe to run next to people.
  • Go to the quay. We learn the most by watching our machines work in real ports.
  • Write it down. Decisions, designs and incidents are written so anyone can read them later.
  • Leave it better. Every team leaves the code, the docs and the port better than it found them.

We are a team of about two hundred people, with offices in Oakland and Rotterdam, and many engineers who travel to customer sites for a few weeks each year.
